dct_description_sm: Soil samples (n = 193) were collected in various geomorphic units of the drained basin complexes of Old Crow Flat. Main geomorphic units included polygonal tundra, young drained basin, old drained basin, meander scar oxbow lake complex, paleoshore complex, eroding shore bank, and terrestrialized pond. All soil samples were collected from the active layer. Laboratory analysis included soil total mercury (sTHg), methylmercury (MeHg), nitrogen (N), carbon (C), hydrogen (H), and sulfur (S). Field observations included landform classification and local vegetation.
dct_title_s: Concentrations of total mercury, methylmercury, nitrogen, carbon, hydrogen, and sulfur in soils from drained basins, Old Crow Flats, Yukon, Canada
